timed_thread_binding.reason: the timed region includes driver-thread directory fsyncs, so the driver thread is bound like every worker

binary_provenance.note: rch exec has no artifact-retrieval mechanism; both ELFs are built on a remote worker and copied to the executing host

mount_contract.kernel: real kernel filesystem on read-only loop device

schedule.kind: balanced four-arm interleave with independent kernel and FUSE A/A
schedule.physical_role_assignment: A/B physical mounts exchange logical roles every round
schedule.pre_measurement_quiescence: base and four cloned image files sync_all before mount, then untimed settle after mount identity and initial parity
schedule.cache_regime: identical balanced warm-cache rounds; no global cache drop

filesystems.job_statement: one warm-cache metadata report job: issue 2000 stat calls for one mounted file and aggregate the observed metadata
filesystems.chooser_statement: For operators choosing between FrankenFS FUSE and Linux kernel btrfs for workload=warm_stat on the recorded host, ISA, frequency policy, mount options, and warm-cache regime: this result applies only to operations=2000, requested_worker_threads=1, observed_worker_threads=1, and durability=read_only_no_mutation; do not generalize it to other filesystem, working-set, cache, thread, durability, mount, or hardware shapes.

candidate.name: FrankenFS FUSE
candidate.boundary: Linux VFS through two independent FrankenFS FUSE mounts

incumbent.name: Linux kernel btrfs
incumbent.boundary: Linux VFS through two independent in-kernel btrfs mounts
